source.work: An Exceptionally Simple Theory of Everything
source.checked: Original visually checked p3 nonabelian color bracket; p7 singlet/triplet source, p16 Table9 mixed roots, p21 8 tensor color/anti-color/singlets, p23 E8 into so(7,1)+so(8)+8x8 carriers, p24 first-gen negative H2, p27 first-gen action operator versus component, p28 other generations not understood.

original_layers.source: Other two triality-related fermionic actions not understood well enough to write down.

findings.claim: For row/matrix fermions Psi and a noncommuting right Lie matrix X, rho(X)Psi=-Psi X is a Lie representation, since [rho(X),rho(Y)]=rho([X,Y]); naive sigma(X)Psi=+Psi X is an anti-representation and fails the same Lie bracket on nonabelian sectors.
findings.model: Exact matrix units E01,E12,E02 in gl(4,Q) with E01*E12=E02 and reverse product zero; strong su3 complexified witness, NOT an original E8 structure-constant reconstruction.

findings.claim: Formal coefficient agreement with a plus right term requires X_component=-X_operator if the fermion matrix carrier, multiplication direction, and other coefficients are fixed. This global raw matrix minus is not a same-bracket Lie-algebra basis conjugation on the nonabelian strong sector; [-X,-Y]=[X,Y] differs from -[X,Y].

A genuine contragredient representation exists on the transposed dual carrier: chi=Psi^T and rho_dual(X)chi=-X^T chi. It respects nonabelian brackets and reproduces the right action, but moves action from right to left and changes carrier. Source does not give an explicit identification of the printed right-component coefficients with this dual carrier.

If strong g acts block diagonally on a colored triplet plus one lepton singlet with zero singlet block, Psi*g=(Psi*P_q)*g, so omission of the _q subscript from the p27 g term can be representation shorthand. This is a compatible model, not an independently derived exact E8 matrix action.

For a fixed uniform odd anti-Grassmann pairing order and even connection coefficients, switching Grassmann order or reversing the exterior 3form/1form order changes the sign of all similarly paired sectors, not only the four H2 right sectors; Clifford gamma/coframe contraction and the 1/4 Higgs factor do not supply a right-only sign.

Original printed p24 and p27 retain a negative H2 right operator, while the last displayed p27 component line uses four positive right terms. Neither a source-native right-generator-to-component change of basis nor an exact Grassmann/Clifford trace convention identifying them has yet been specified in the frozen paper.

source_capabilities_missing: Source-specified 8x8 strong/mixed H2 representation simultaneously compatible with original E8 root-vector phases, real form and right chiral fermion carriers.
Source-approved map from H2 Lie generator coefficients to p27 right component matrices (including whether opposite/dual/transpose or charge-conjugate representations are used).
Source-selected fermion/anti-fermion right-module identification, chiral conjugation, trace/Grassmann scalar pairing and external-form ordering to prove the complete action, not only a chosen model.
Unambiguous treatment of colored quarks, anticolored antiquarks, singlet leptons in the same fermion action and triality for other generations.

independent_exact_verification.model: 2x4 rational/integer rectangular fermion; 4x4 sparse noncommuting strong roots; 2x2 left actors; source-conditioned Grassmann/exterior/Clifford simple probes
